title: Width of the Threshold-Parity Circuit
statement: For every integer $m\geq 7$, consider the circuit on $2^m$ sign-valued inputs whose first layer consists of one minterm for each pair comprising an index $b\in\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$ and a sign assignment to $2m$ positions, with those positions mapped to the corresponding block coordinates. The maximum number of literals in a first-layer term, which is the circuit's width, is exactly $2m$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number m with 7 ≤ m
